title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: He responded, “Hey Anthony - Great to hear from you ...”
The phrase “This Guy” was originally reserved for him haha
Hey Greg, great to get my ass kicked in Words With Friends by you
I feel like you have to be even more positive to be at Morosi’s level.
“Hey Greg, great to have you kick my ass. I should be so fortunate to have a chance to play this great game.”
